header.question: Q5: how soon after a Set does the readback show it? Each setting is set and put back, and read 0, 10, 50, 100 and 300 ms after each Set returned: Primary Output gain and low-pass filter, Holding, the mode, and every compensation enable and value; in V-Clamp, and Pipette Capacitance Neutralization and Bridge Balance in I-Clamp.
